items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: This is the grandson of Booker T. Washington.

ctx.x: And by that time -- by that time Booker Pittman had become very proficient on his alto, and --
This is Booker Pittman, this is the grandson of Booker T. Washington.

This is the grandson of Booker T. Washington. In fact, he was named after his grandfather, Booker Taliaferro Pittman, and Mr. Pittman, who his father was, who married Portia Pittman, which was Booker T. Washington's oldest daughter, in fact, Booker and me were sort of in the crib together, because the families -- my family and his family was very tight.
